scientific_integrity: Half-flux caging and magnetic band structure are credited to earlier work. The assessed contribution is the explicit asymptotic divergence exponent and prefactor of terminal mean absorption time.
scientific_limitations: One excitation, finite open unit-hopping diamond chain, one terminal loss channel; fixed length and positive sink rate before flux detuning. No uniform large-length or weak-loss result. Historical priority not exhaustively independently checked.
title: Distance-amplified flux-detuning law for absorption in a finite diamond quantum chain
